payload.text: vc 2026-10-31 17:07Z (dc's WP17 question, measured on main): D57's record keys on platform_identity (uname -srm and the bash version, the seal's platform: line), an identity, not a word, so no word derivation exists today. Ruled: one platform_word in lib/helpers, macos for Darwin and linux for Linux, no word otherwise, the one place the OS name is mapped to D69's words; a platforms: gate is inactive on a host with no word. platform_identity stays D57's key: it is a different fact (the OS build a seal stood on), and keying the seal on the word would re-run every remembered green once and stop seal_verdict telling two OS builds apart. lib/cmd/macos's own uname -s check moves onto platform_word, since it asks the same question; file_immutable keeps its Darwin and BSD arm, which asks which stat to use. WP03's remainder landed at ebc38b18 the same hour.
